title: Cross margin selectable in Pro margin mode chooser when flag is on
description: TAT-3524. Data prerequisites: fixture Trading account (currently selected), HyperLiquid testnet, BTC market in Pro with no BTC position or resting order (converged by setup nodes, since an open position locks the margin mode); perpsCrossMarginEnabled pinned on and perpsTerminalBackendEnabled pinned off via metamask.feature_flags.set and cleared at teardown.

setup-flag.intent: Turn the cross margin rollout flag on like the reporter did, with the Terminal market backend off since it drops the no-Cross asset restriction and keeps Cross disabled (TAT-4022)

setup-pro.intent: Open the BTC market in Pro mode on HyperLiquid testnet with the fixture trading account

setup-no-btc-position.intent: Start from no BTC position so the margin mode is free to change

setup-no-btc-orders.intent: Start from no resting BTC orders so the margin mode is free to change

setup-show-margin-control.intent: Let the trader see the margin and leverage controls of the order form

setup-open-order-type.intent: Open the order type chooser so the trade starts as a market order

setup-basic-tab.intent: Show the basic order types, since a saved advanced order type opens the chooser on another tab

setup-wait-market-type.intent: Confirm the Market order type is offered

setup-pick-market-type.intent: Start from a market order regardless of the saved order type

gate-margin-button.intent: Confirm the Pro order form margin mode control is on screen

ac1-open-sheet.intent: Open the margin mode chooser the way a trader would

ac1-wait-cross-option.intent: Confirm the Cross choice is shown in the margin mode chooser

ac1-press-cross.intent: Pick Cross margin for the next trade

ac1-wait-sheet-closed.intent: Confirm picking Cross closes the chooser and returns to the order form

ac1-show-margin-control.intent: Let reviewers see the margin control right after Cross was picked, clear of the sticky header

ac1-wait-cross-label.intent: Confirm the order form margin control now reads Cross

ac1-screenshot-cross-label.intent: Show the order form margin control reading Cross after the trader picked it
ac1-screenshot-cross-label.label: AC1: order form shows Cross margin

ac1-reopen-sheet.intent: Reopen the chooser to show Cross is the active choice

ac1-wait-cross-selected.intent: Confirm the chooser reopens with the Cross choice on screen

ac1-screenshot-cross-sheet.intent: Show Cross is selectable and selected, without the coming soon note
ac1-screenshot-cross-sheet.label: AC1: Cross selectable in margin mode chooser

ac2-keep-cross.intent: Confirm Cross as the margin mode for the trade

ac2-wait-sheet-closed.intent: Confirm the trader is back on the order form with Cross kept

ac2-scroll-size.intent: Let the trader see where the trade size is entered

ac2-wait-size.intent: Confirm the order size field is ready for input

ac2-set-size.intent: Enter a small 15 USD trade size like a trader would

ac2-scroll-submit.intent: Let the trader reach the button that sends the Cross trade

ac2-wait-submit.intent: Confirm the place order button is reachable

ac2-press-submit.intent: Place the Cross margin long on BTC testnet

ac2-assert-position-open.intent: Confirm the Cross order actually opened a BTC position

ac2-filter-btc.intent: Narrow the positions list to BTC so the new position card is shown on its own

ac2-swipe-to-positions.intent: Let reviewers see the positions panel below the order form

ac2-swipe-to-card.intent: Let reviewers see the margin details of the new BTC position card

ac2-wait-cross-tag.intent: Confirm the venue reports the new BTC position as Cross margin

ac2-screenshot-cross-position.intent: Show reviewers the placed BTC position is tagged Cross
ac2-screenshot-cross-position.label: AC2: placed BTC position is Cross margin

teardown-close-btc.intent: Close the test BTC position so the testnet account returns to flat

teardown-assert-flat.intent: Confirm the testnet account holds no BTC position after cleanup

teardown-unfilter-btc.intent: Restore the positions list to all markets for later runs

teardown-clear-flag.intent: Drop the flag override so the slot does not leak the variant

ac2-run-order-params-tests.intent: Prove the picked margin mode reaches the placed order parameters
ac2-run-order-params-tests.cmd:
yarn jest app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsProMarketView/components/PerpsProOrderForm/usePerpsProOrderForm.test.ts app/components/UI/Perps/utils/orderParams.test.ts -t 'margin mode' --modulePathIgnorePatterns '<rootDir>/temp/' --no-coverage > temp/tasks/feat/tat-3524-0925-174920/artifacts/test-logs/ac2-jest.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -50 temp/tasks/feat/tat-3524-0925-174920/artifacts/test-logs/ac2-jest.log
exit $status

ac2-assert-tests-pass.intent: Confirm the order parameter margin mode tests passed

ac3-run-gating-tests.intent: Prove Cross stays unavailable when the flag is off or the market cannot trade cross
ac3-run-gating-tests.cmd:
yarn jest app/components/UI/Perps/components/PerpsMarginModeBottomSheet/PerpsMarginModeBottomSheet.test.tsx app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsProMarketView/components/PerpsProOrderFormPanel.test.tsx -t 'cross margin' --modulePathIgnorePatterns '<rootDir>/temp/' --no-coverage > temp/tasks/feat/tat-3524-0925-174920/artifacts/test-logs/ac3-jest.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -50 temp/tasks/feat/tat-3524-0925-174920/artifacts/test-logs/ac3-jest.log
exit $status

ac3-assert-tests-pass.intent: Confirm the cross margin gating tests passed

ac4-run-cross-position-tests.intent: Prove an existing cross position no longer blocks trading when Cross is available
ac4-run-cross-position-tests.cmd:
yarn jest app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsProMarketView/components/PerpsProOrderForm/usePerpsProOrderForm.test.ts -t 'existing cross position' --modulePathIgnorePatterns '<rootDir>/temp/' --no-coverage > temp/tasks/feat/tat-3524-0925-174920/artifacts/test-logs/ac4-jest.log 2>&1
status=$?
tail -50 temp/tasks/feat/tat-3524-0925-174920/artifacts/test-logs/ac4-jest.log
exit $status

ac4-assert-tests-pass.intent: Confirm the existing cross position tests passed
